checks.label: To find the gradient of a line joining two points, divide the difference in the y-coordinates by the difference in the x-coordinates: every row of working ends in its rise ÷ its run, and each puzzle accepts only that answer
Vertical lines have a gradient which is undefined: on the line straight up, and in the puzzle where B stands straight above A, the run is zero and the working ends in undefined instead of a number
The gradient is a measure of how steep the line is: with A held still, each step higher for B makes the drawn line steeper and its m bigger
The slope of the line is the resistance, or the voltage divided by the current: on the volts screen the gradient equals each reading's voltage divided by its current
The units of resistance are volts per ampere: the volts screen gives its gradient in V per A, then in ohms

Every worked number is right, row by row: 6 ÷ 3 = 2 (3 ÷ 6 = 0.5 the wrong way up), 6 ÷ 2 = 3, 2 ÷ 1 and 10 ÷ 5 = 2, 4 ÷ 2 and 6 ÷ 3 = 2 (3 × 2 = 6), −6 ÷ 3 = −2 twice, 6 ÷ 3 and −6 ÷ −3 = 2, 9 ÷ 3 = 3, 0 ÷ 4 = 0, 5 ÷ 0 and 7 ÷ 0 undefined, 15 V ÷ 3 A = 5 V per A, 200 litres ÷ 4 minutes = 50, −6 ÷ 6 = −1, and −12 ÷ 6 = 12 ÷ −6 = −2
Any two points on one straight line give the same m: on the slide screen, every pair of whole-number points along its line gives 2
The arrows give the sign: every run arrow points right exactly when its run is positive and every rise arrow up exactly when its rise is positive; starting from B turns both round but keeps m
Before an answer a puzzle draws no new triangle and its working reads ?; a right answer draws the triangle and fills in the working, and every wrong answer has a hint of its own
Every wrong answer offered is a real slip, worked from the puzzle's own points: the run over the rise, the rise alone, a lost minus, dropped brackets or a mixed order
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 4.5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; a puzzle's triangle draws within 2.5 s

warnings: SVG labels "−4" and "−3" are only 4 px apart on one row, so they read as one: leave at least 4 px between them, or label only what differs (at step = step 8, and 1 more setting) [at 340 px wide]
